_comment: CONTROLLED TEMPLATE. These terms are inserted verbatim by code; no LLM may write or alter them. Have counsel review before use.

Work on integrations not listed in this proposal
Ongoing hosting or maintenance after the support period unless separately agreed in writing

Timelines begin after payment is confirmed and required access is provided

refund_policy: Refunds and cancellations are handled only by a human representative; none are promised in this proposal.
